newsitem.title: MEXICO: Greenpeace says its boat harassed by Mexican navy.
newsitem.headline: Greenpeace says its boat harassed by Mexican navy.

text.p: The environmental group Greenpeace said on Wednesday that its Rainbow Warrior boat had been harassed by a Mexican navy warship.
Greenpeace said that since it left the port city of Ciudad del Carmen in the Gulf of Mexico last Monday, a Mexican navy frigate has followed menacingly close behind.

"Since we left, the Mexican navy has followed us like a shadow. The warship has been on the horizon behind the Rainbow Warrior for the past two days," said Bart Terwiel, the captain of the Greenpeace boat.
French commandos sunk the original Rainbow Warrior vessel in the South Pacific in 1985 when the boat was used by environmentalists to protest against nuclear testing in the area by France.
For the past two weeks, Greenpeace officials have travelled up and down the Mexican Gulf Coast to denouce environmental damage caused in the area by state oil and gas firm Petroleos Mexicanos.
